findings.title: Target table and columns confirmed
findings.description: Data source deepseek@localhost (MySQL 9.2.0, jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/deepseek) is configured; catalog deepseek exists; the COMPANY table exists with 6 columns including ID (INT, NOT NULL) and COMPANY_STATE (VARCHAR 255, nullable).
findings.recommendation: None required; the mapped table and both referenced columns resolve in the target catalog.

findings.title: Null companyState silently matches nothing
findings.description: COMPANY_STATE is nullable in the schema; a null companyState parameter yields WHERE COMPANY_STATE = NULL, which matches no rows per SQL three-valued logic, so the delete silently no-ops.
findings.recommendation: Pass a non-null companyState from callers, or validate the parameter before invocation.

findings.title: Primary index resolves the ID predicate
findings.description: COMPANY has a PRIMARY unique index on ID, so the equality predicate on ID is index-resolved and the delete is row-targeted.
findings.recommendation: None required; keep the ID + state two-predicate form.
